notes.title: Weapon system update
notes.notes:
Hello people! We just pushed our first update to live. We have fixed a few things:

- Added mouse control for weapons. Now the direction of the weapon is in sync with the first person camera.

- Increased Steer Angle to 70 degrees (was 45), now the turning radius is smaller. 

- Slightly optimized physics and bounding boxes. If you still experience weird things, please let us know. (e.g. falling through the landscape)

- Updated SFX and music. Many people disliked the previous menu music, is it because it was loud & there was no audio settings or because of the music itself?

- Objects are dynamically spawned by the backend now. (Sorry, we were lazy and hard-coded those values in C++.)

- Added graphics options.
